figurative_meaning_en: An ingredient or item that enhances or stimulates the taste in the mouth
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভাতের আগে একটু মুখরুচি খেয়ে নাও।
example_sentences_in_english: Have a little appetizer before the rice.
This pickle is a great mouth refresher.
note: Refers to items like pickles or starters in Bengali cuisine that stimulate appetite.
